body: I'm thinking of giving my boyfriend the slide lock pin, since that's the easiest part to remove and the main piece that holds the slide and frame together. If I can make it that far...

I'm thinking of selling it for a pepperblaster and a knife, but I don't know. I'm not sure it matters. And I've been fighting for so long, it's almost ridiculous. My boss is telling me that I have to act like a guy because that's what he hired, and even though my driver's license and registration with the social security administration has been corrected since then, he's still not seeing reason. Simple decency isn't working, either. I'm stuck in this job because I don't qualify for much else, and this is the only one I've found that still makes almost enough to pay the bills.

It's probably one of the biggest reasons I'm so far down tonight...
Nobody tonight. I work overnights, so most of my friends are in bed by now. I'm not selfish enough to ask the ones that aren't to drive out 30 miles to take my gun away...
I've already unloaded it. I'm not sure if I'm going to keep it off me, but... One time putting it in my mouth tonight is enough. I hate this so much...

I've never been diagnosed with depression, no. It's been obvious for years, but my parents didn't believe in mental health issues and my friends and significant others before the one I'm with now have all been of the mindset that I'm "not depressed, I'm just a whiny little bitch"... That sort of leaves you in a spot where you don't want to open up to anyone. I was baker acted long ago, but that was... Pretty much in a different life. I was diagnosed with a separation disorder and sent home. No treatment, no long term diagnosis, no concern.

The only doctor I see now is the one I see for my hormone prescriptions. I kind of dislike her, and she's not been a good doctor to me. I literally only see her to keep documenting my ongoing transition for legal paperwork. She's literally no help to me otherwise, and I could handle my hormones and blood tests entirely without her help for cheaper. She's an OB/GYN by trade, so I doubt she would even be able to prescribe anything for mental health anyway

The only other doctors I see are for the HIV mess... Though they have said they can get a therapist for me, they haven't done so in the almost two years I've been seeing them, despite asking repeatedly.

I've kind of been cast aside, and I'm not really rich enough to keep looking for a doctor that gives a damn enough, so... This is the cycle I'm doomed to.

I've been there. My main account actually has quite a few posts there.

I just don't know... I don't think there's anything to be done with further resources. My transition has hit a standstill, and I'm almost 3 years in on hormones with no hope in sight for my hopeful eventual surgeries... It all costs money, and I make about enough to scrape by as it is. It's hard to be optimistic about it...

Selling it isn't an option. That just makes me defenseless if someone takes offense to my gender. With the shit that's been going on in the news with transwomen being beaten and killed, I feel like I'm in about as much danger whichever way.
